name: ScnMsg
meaning: generic scenaric message ids passed to an object's HandleMessage (vtable +0x10: this, sender, msgId, arg); class-specific ids live in <Class>Msg enums

name: MSG_KILL
meaning: arg = WolfKillType-style cause. Rocks crumble only on arg 0 (Dynamite 300, mines 300 / 550 Rocks-only, CannonBall 70); Bush respawns on arg 0 or 2 (SmallRock shatter sends arg 2); Piranhas send arg 9 to the Wolf and the InflatableSheep

name: MSG_USE
meaning: (object-side meaning; ids are per receiver) the player's action on an object (Wolf/Robot): Mailbox opens, TimeKeeper rings and awards, box/FloatingBox are delivered, MCardManager opens the save UI (CinematicsManager fallback)

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: (object-side meaning; ids are per receiver) context-action query from ScnControllable_ScanInteractables; returns a WolfContextAction (Mailbox 3, TimeKeeper 0x1E). To MCardManager it returns 0x21 when idle and the sender is the CinematicsManager

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: existing name (FanMsg etc.); every receiver attaches itself to the sender's joint = arg. Other spellings MSG_ATTACH / MENU_MSG_FOCUS are other namespaces or duplicates

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: existing name; every receiver detaches and moves to the DropMsgArg / Vec3s in arg

name: MSG_QUERY_NEAREST_TARGET
meaning: Wolf_ScanContextActions asks the held item (arg = &wolf+0x660). The reply {s16 classId; u16 proximity 0..0xffff} makes Hud_DrawItemPrompt draw that class's icon, reddish 0x502828 when proximity < 0xe665 and dark blue 0x101050 otherwise. Answered by the Fan (the sheep report relayed from the Perfume), the Flute (Sam within 300) and the Salad

name: MSG_INVENTORY_STORED
meaning: sent to item before storing in inventory

name: MSG_INVENTORY_TAKE_OUT
meaning: sent to an item as it leaves the inventory: Wolf_EquipItem 0x48f1a8 (then AddToWorld and msg 4), Inventory_DropUncommitted 0x50d297 and 0x542228 (both immediately before Inventory_Remove). Counterpart of MSG_INVENTORY_STORED (stored). Hoover arms on it; HoneyPot acknowledges

name: MSG_CONTAINER_STATE
meaning: arg 0: the item is put in a container and removed from the world (Mailbox_Init 0x4d311a, Mailbox_Rollback 0x4d360f); arg 1: released into the world (box 0x49cf61, FloatingBox 0x4bf7aa/0x4bfb44), where Salad and SignPostSimple take their position as home. Not a checkpoint message

name: MSG_PUSH
meaning: per receiver: see RockMsg, SmallRockMsg

name: MSG_SEESAW_TOUCH
meaning: existing name; seesaw_Update tells objects on the plank (arg = plank delta.y); CannonBall2/GroundMine/Robot/Rock/SmallRock react

name: MSG_LAUNCH
meaning: existing name; arg = LaunchArc: Wolf -> WOLF_ST_TRAJECTORY, Rock/SmallRock/Robot launched (seesaw, bull)

name: MSG_GROUND_QUERY
meaning: arg = GroundQuery*; handler answers with Box_GroundQueryFlatTop / Box_GroundQueryDome (name inferred)

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: freeze the Wolf: the sender becomes his grabber and he stops taking input (refused in WolfStateFlags 0x200 states). About 25 objects send it: Prompt_Begin and Dialog_Begin, signs, cameras, Sam carrying him, the catapult, the telescope... When another object freezes him, the Wolf sends 0xe to the previous grabber so it learns it lost him (the receivers' rows). Was SCN_MSG_UI_FREEZE, a name for the prompt senders only

name: MSG_UNFREEZE
meaning: release the Wolf again (Wolf::Unfreeze 0x48d3ee); sent by Prompt_End, Dialog_Update, Dialog_UpdateAnswer and the objects that froze him. Was SCN_MSG_UI_UNFREEZE

name: MSG_CARRY_ANIM
meaning: per receiver: see FanMsg, FishingRodMsg, HairDryerMsg, MineDetectorMsg, RobotMsg, RocketMsg, SheepMsg, TimeMachineChronoMsg, UmbrellaMsg

name: MSG_BUMP
meaning: sent by the bull AND by Wolf_RunMove 0x48bea7 when Ralph runs into an object whose class lacks flag 0x8 at >= half speed (not only a bull bump). Cactus plays its reaction anim when Ralph is within 400

name: MSG_CINE_PLACE
meaning: existing name; Cine::NotifyActors walks actors to their start (Wolf WolfWalkToArg)

name: MSG_CINE_END
meaning: existing name; Cine::Finish to every actor (Wolf back to idle, Rock/SmallRock fall)

name: MSG_FAN_BLOW
meaning: sent by the Fan (0x4bb62e, called only from Fan_Update 0x4bbb91) to objects within 400 units, arg = s16. Bush: rustle this frame. Recipients: inside a cone of heading difference <= 0x199 out to 400 units, or overlapping the Fan holder's box.

name: MSG_HELD_STATE_BEGIN
meaning: Wolf -> held object, arg = state descriptor nibble

name: MSG_HELD_STATE_END
meaning: Wolf -> held object

name: MSG_QUERY_HELD_ACTION
meaning: per receiver: see ElasticMsg, FanMsg, FishingRodMsg, FluteMsg, GoldenCoinsMsg, HairDryerMsg, HoneyPotMsg, HooverMsg, InflatableSheepMsg, InstantHooverMsg, KeyMsg, MineDetectorMsg, MineMsg, PerfumeMsg, RemoteControlMsg, RobotMsg, RocketMsg, SaladMsg, SeedMsg, SheepMsg, SmallRockMsg, TimeMachineChronoMsg, UmbrellaMsg

name: MSG_RIDER_ADD
meaning: existing name; registers the sender as a move modifier (Wolf/Robot AddMoveModifier, CannonBall2, GroundMine)

name: MSG_RIDER_REMOVE
meaning: existing name; the counterpart: RemoveMoveModifier

name: MSG_MODIFY_MOVE
meaning: controllable -> registered move modifiers, arg {Vec3s delta; u16 flags; Vec3s vel}

name: MSG_MAILBOX_DELIVERED
meaning: Mailbox_Deliver -> the LVL03ROCK Rock (Lvl-03): Rock_HandleMessage case 0x1b sets +0x5c lvl03BoxDelivered = 1, so the rock uses the LVL03WITHBOX cinematic

name: MSG_QUERY_MOVED
meaning: per receiver: see BullMsg, SheepMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_LOUD_NOISE
meaning: broadcast with Scenaric_BroadcastInRadius, arg = the noise source's class id. Senders: Dynamite (radius 3000, arg 2) and the playing Flute (radius 600, +-200 vertical, arg = holder class, 0 for the Wolf). The bull wakes on any arg (BullMsg MSG_LOUD_NOISE); Sam alerts only when arg == 2 and the sender is in his authorized zone, so the Flute never alerts Sam this way

name: MSG_BULL_TARGET_QUERY
meaning: bull_TargetScoreCB asks candidates; a reply of 1 makes them charge targets (Gossamer_Lev08 0x454861 answers 1 while inside its box)

name: MSG_SWITCH_ON
meaning: SuperButton 0x4f8ac8 sends it to one of its targets; Wooden Lift sets active and dir = dirOn

name: MSG_SWITCH_OFF
meaning: SuperButton's opposite-phase message; Wooden Lift clears active and dir = dirOff

name: MSG_MECHANISM_RUN
meaning: WoodenPlatForm to DoorMechanism while moving; DoorMechanism 0x4b428c sets +0x7c = 1 (animates)

name: MSG_MECHANISM_STOP
meaning: sent on arrival; DoorMechanism +0x7c = 0

name: MSG_SCRIPT_HOLD
meaning: per receiver: see InflatableSheepMsg, SamMsg, SheepMsg

name: MSG_SCRIPT_RELEASE
meaning: per receiver: see InflatableSheepMsg, SamMsg, SheepMsg

name: MSG_LANDED
meaning: sent by elastic_Update, Catapult_Update and bull_Update to a thrown object when its flight ends; Bush respawns at home; also sent by seesaw_RemoveLaunch 0x4ef04e

name: MSG_QUERY_COVER
meaning: secondary query in ScnControllable_ScanInteractables (result goes to Wolf coverAction.action +0x650, shown as the SNEAK prompt); HiddenRocks returns 1 within 10 units XZ

name: MSG_SEESAW_DRIFT
meaning: sender seesaw_Update with arg = &drift; no handler case found in src (the existing names MSG_FORCE_SLIDE (Wolf) / MSG_SEESAW_LAUNCH conflict); inferred

name: MSG_ITEM_SPLIT_QUERY
meaning: asks a composite item for its two components; returns them by pointer (Map_SplitItem)

name: MSG_ITEM_COMBINE
meaning: Map_CombineItems sends it to the combined product it has already found, with the two parts as input (it does not return the product by pointer)

name: MSG_ITEM_CONSUMED
meaning: tells a composite it has been taken apart (Map_SplitItem)

name: MSG_HITSWITCH_BULL
meaning: HitSwitch relays a bull's MSG_BUMP to its target with arg = the bull; no receiver case found; inferred

name: MSG_SET_ANCHOR
meaning: existing SheepMsg name (ScnClassFlags 0x800 = SCN_CF_SHEEP_ANCHORABLE); senders Catapult, Raft, RCarpetMobile, seesaw

name: MSG_DETECTOR_PING
meaning: per receiver: see GoldenCoinsMsg, MineMsg

name: MSG_GEYSER_OUT
meaning: existing name; GeyserOut to its passenger / touched objects; box sets canRelease = 1

name: MSG_GEYSER_IN
meaning: existing name; GeyserIn/WaterGeyser to the victim, returns the transit time; box canRelease = 0

name: MSG_ICECUBE_RESET
meaning: IceCube case 0x32: SetState(0), melted/heated/meltTime cleared; sender DaffyMilitary::Reset

name: MSG_TRAP_STATE
meaning: existing name; WolfTrap tells victim/Sam/Bell it caught (arg 1) or released (0); Bell rings; LightSpot to Sam

name: MSG_ATTRACT_REPORT
meaning: 'I am attracted to you': arg -> {u16 classId; u16 proximity = dist*0xffff/range}. Sheep_TestScentSource 0x477790 sends it to a scent source; the Perfume relays its stored report to the blowing Fan. Both keep the smallest proximity within 0x800 ticks

name: MSG_RIVER_ADD_CARGO
meaning: FrozenRiver case 0x36: adds the sender as cargo when it is over the water boxes (Wolf, Sheep, SlidingIceCube)

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_CALL
meaning: existing name; TimeMachineSphere asks the follower (Dragon/Gossamer) to follow (arg = &followerTarget); Sam answers whether he can be called, bull -> state 8

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_LOCK
meaning: per receiver: see DragonMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_ARRIVE
meaning: per receiver: see DragonMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_SWAP
meaning: sent by the TimeMachineSphere code (0x4fbb87, SwapToPresent 0x4fbce1, 0x4fbec2) with arg {ScnObject *partner; Vec3s pos}. FogManager switches fog; HiddenRocks moves to pos; SheepMsg 0x3B is the sheep's variant

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_SWAP_OUT
meaning: TimeMachineSphere to the copy of a designer-listed pair in the era being left, arg {ScnObject *partner; Vec3s pos mapped into the receiver's era}. Handled by TimeMachineChrono (returns 1) and 0x43b83b / 0x4ea560 (Seed); counterpart of MSG_TIMEMACHINE_SWAP 0x3b

name: MSG_SWIRLSIGN_TURN
meaning: SwirlSign case 0x3d: turns to the other face (state 1 -> 3, 0 -> 2); sender DaffyLevel09 state 5

name: MSG_RIVER_CRANE_BUSY
meaning: FrozenRiver case 0x3e: craneBusy = arg (Crane sets 1 on catch, 0 when done)

name: MSG_REMOTE_SWITCH
meaning: per receiver: see InstantHooverMsg, RobotMsg

name: MSG_STRUGGLE
meaning: existing name; WolfTrap to the victim per struggle press

name: MSG_THAW
meaning: HairDryer_Blow 0x4c8e2a, every frame, to objects in its +-0x199 / 400-unit cone, arg 0. Sheep: ice cube 0x24 -> 0x26; FloatingBox: flag 0x200 in its state 1

name: MSG_WHEEL_SPIN
meaning: Wheel to the boss (arg &bossMsgSender) and to the carried mobile (arg spinStep); Diamond slides by arg; Gossamer_Boss takes its chase target

name: MSG_TELEPORTED
meaning: Diamond::TeleportZone to every moved object (arg = dx) and to the sender on seat; Wheel/Gossamer_Boss shift, signs return 1

name: MSG_AXIS_LOCK
meaning: per receiver: see RobotMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_CANNONBALL_HIT
meaning: CannonBall::SweepMove to a movable object it hits, arg 1000; no receiver case found; inferred

name: MSG_BEES_STING
meaning: existing SamMsg name; Bees to the victim when alert == 3 (other spelling MSG_ENTER_CD conflicts)

name: MSG_QUERY_CONTROLLED
meaning: existing name; LightSpot asks the robot, RollingCarpet asks the rider (MSG_QUERY_NOT_FROZEN is the Wolf-side spelling)

name: MSG_BALL_RETURNED
meaning: CannonBall to its launcher and every pipe (arg = hit class): CanonSheep/CanonSimple re-place the ball, Pipe/Pipe2/Rook reset

name: MSG_HOOVER_SUCK
meaning: InstantHoover::SuckMartians: InstantMartian runs to the sender (state 3)

name: MSG_MAGNET_QUERY
meaning: Magnet_Update to every object within 400 units of attractPos each frame; nonzero = magnetic. Answered by Robot (always 1), GroundMine (proximity mode) and CannonBall2 0x4a518b (1 unless its state byte +0x86 == 2)

name: MSG_MAGNET_PULL
meaning: arg {ScnObject *other; s32 reply}: to each magnetic candidate (other = magnet), and in hand also to the holder for the first catch (other = candidate; Wolf stores it at +0x63c and enters state 0xC8). The Magnet is the only sender

name: MSG_CHECKPOINT_ROLLBACK
meaning: Inventory_DropUncommitted: arg 0 to each dropped item, arg 1 to each mailbox; Mailbox reverts an uncommitted state via 0x4d35c8 (name inferred)

name: MSG_QUERY_MOVING
meaning: per receiver: see RockMsg, SheepMsg

name: MSG_GEYSER_ZONE_ACTIVE
meaning: GeyserManger to its geysers: arg 1 always update, 0 normal (GeyserIn/GeyserOut)

name: MSG_GHOST_NOTICE
meaning: Monolithe to praying ghosts with arg = the frozen target; the leader alerts the others (0x4501)

name: MSG_JAMS_STATION_ACTIVE
meaning: existing TrafficJams name; TrafficJams to the station ring (arg = arrivingTimeMs)

name: MSG_PIPE_EJECT
meaning: CannonBall to a pipe: Pipe -> state 4 / Pipe2 -> 3 with launchStart

name: MSG_PIPE_RELEASE
meaning: Pipe2 case 0x65: box collision on, occupied = 0

name: MSG_PIPE_ARM
meaning: CanonSimple to its pipes: SetState(0), armed = 1

name: MSG_HONEY_VICTIM
meaning: HoneyPot tells the hive and bees who is in the honey (arg = object)

name: MSG_SHEEP_CALL
meaning: existing SheepMsg name; the Wolf (sheep costume) broadcasts it to class 0xb Sheep

name: MSG_ONDE_START
meaning: Gossamer_Boss SHAKE to the GossamerOnde: shockwave starts at the sender

name: MSG_BULLET_DONE
meaning: Bullet to Elmer after the kill (Elmer state 0xc) and Bullet case 0x6f: SetState(5)

name: MSG_GHOST_BOO
meaning: the Wolf in the ghost costume broadcasts it to class 0x78 (Ghost): state 8/9 -> wolfBooed

name: MSG_GATE_QUERY
meaning: existing FallingGate2 name; BipbipLevel14 and Sam_Pirate query the gate

name: MSG_MAGNET_CONTACT
meaning: Magnet to a caught object within about 65 units (dist2 <= 0x1081); only CannonBall2 handles it (sets mask 0x2 (bit 1) of +0x87). Name inferred

name: MSG_VOICE_STARTED
meaning: sent to g_letterboxVoiceTarget when the queued cinematic voice line begins

name: MSG_COLLIDE_IGNORE_QUERY
meaning: sent to the MOVER with sender NULL and arg = candidate object; nonzero return = do not collide with it

name: MSG_LIFT_CRUSH
meaning: Wooden Lift to a Salad (class 3) or Bush (0x30) under it before refusing to descend; both handlers set an internal flag. The effect is not traced, so the name is inferred

name: MSG_WOLF_CAUGHT
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_NOISY
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_VISIBLE
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_SHEEPCOSTUME
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_RUNNING
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_DEAD
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_RABBITCOSTUME
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_CATCHABLE
meaning: per receiver: see SamMsg, WolfMsg

name: MSG_CHECKPOINT_COMMIT
meaning: Inventory_CommitAtCheckpoint to mailboxes (arg 1); Mailbox sets its committed bit 4

name: MSG_CAMRESTRICT_ENABLE
meaning: CameraRestriction only: arg 0 = update NEVER (off); arg 1 = update ALWAYS (back on). The factory 0x4a1666 already sets ALWAYS, so arg 1 only undoes an earlier arg 0. Senders 0x45d83e, 0x4b5b5b, 0x4b6e42, 0x4b8f6e

name: MSG_CHECKPOINT_ACTIVATE
meaning: CheckpointManager handles msgId == 0x1080; PrayingGhost state 14 sends it

name: MSG_CINE_REARM
meaning: CinematicsManager: clear 'played' on the trigger whose actBox == arg. Sender 0x43ef00 (DaffyTrainingLevel range)

name: MSG_INVENTORY_STORE_BEGIN
meaning: sent to head item before inventory store

name: MSG_GEYSER_CTRL_STATE
meaning: GeyserIn to its controller: arg 1 idle/corked, 0 active; GeyserIn case: flag 4 = arg

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_START
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2880: always update and SetState(1)

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_CORK
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2881: SetFlag(8), SetState(3)

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_UNCORK
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2882: ClearFlag(8), state 1 or 0

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_SET_DELAY
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2883: spitDelay = arg (activePeriod)

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_IS_BUSY
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2884: returns Flag(1)

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_GET_CAMERA
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2885: returns its camera

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_SET_PASSENGER
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2886: passenger = arg

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_WANTS_WOLF_CAM
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2887: returns Flag(0x40); GeyserIn flag 0x10 (camera for the Wolf)

name: MSG_GEYSEROUT_WANTS_OBJ_CAM
meaning: GeyserOut case 0x2888: returns Flag(2); GeyserIn flag 0x20 (camera for sheep/salad)

name: MSG_WOLFTRAP_RESET
meaning: WolfTrap case 0x2c80: Reset(); sender Robot

name: MSG_SWIRLSIGN_IS_B
meaning: SwirlSign case 0x3080: returns 1 in state 1

name: MSG_SWIRLSIGN_IS_A
meaning: SwirlSign case 0x3081: returns 1 in state 0

name: MSG_TREESECTION_CUT
meaning: TreeSection: msgId == 0x3181 -> SetState(1); sender Elmer::SetState

name: MSG_BULLET_FIRE
meaning: Bullet case 0x3200: SetState(1); sender Elmer

name: MSG_BULLET_IS_BUSY
meaning: Bullet case 0x3201: returns state != 5

name: MSG_BULLET_RESET
meaning: Bullet case 0x3202: SetState(5); sender Elmer::Reset

name: MSG_BULLET_SET_POS
meaning: Bullet case 0x3203: SetPosition(arg)

name: MSG_BULLET_SET_BOX
meaning: Elmer::PostLoadInit sends its detectBox; no Bullet case found in the census; inferred

name: MSG_MCARD_AUTOSAVE
meaning: CinematicsManager -> MCardManager for a flag-0x8000 trigger. MCardManager accepts (returns 1, starts autosave) when Progress runtimeBits saveSlotValid (bit 4) and autoSaveOn (bit 5) are set

name: MSG_ROBOT_IS_DRIVEN
meaning: query answered by Robot_HandleMessage 0x460b93: returns 1 when a robot state dword has bit 0x20; the Wooden Lift then tests the robot's position instead of the Wolf's (meaning inferred)

name: MSG_WATCH_TIME_LEFT
meaning: Watch case 0x3780: returns timeLeft (stops at 0)

name: MSG_WATCH_START
meaning: Watch case 0x3781: timeLeft = arg, SetState(1)

name: MSG_WATCH_TICK
meaning: Watch case 0x3782: running = arg, tick sound 0x3f on/off

name: MSG_DAFFY09_IS_PLACARD
meaning: DaffyLevel09 case 0x3801: returns 1 in state 0

name: MSG_BEES_RELEASE
meaning: Bees case 0x3980: alert = arg, SetState(0x13); sender Hive state 4

name: MSG_BEES_HIVE_HIT
meaning: Bees case 0x3981: hitHive = sender, fly to the second hive or wake all; sender Hive::SetState(1)

name: MSG_BEES_GO_MOTHER
meaning: Bees case 0x3982: fly back to the mother hive (state 4)

name: MSG_HIVE_HIT
meaning: Hive case 0x3e01: freezes the Wolf, turns to the sender, SetState(1); sender CannonBall

name: MSG_HIVE_RESET
meaning: Hive case 0x3e02: SetState(0)

name: MSG_HIVE_SWARM_HOME
meaning: Hive case 0x3e03: swarmPresent = 1, swarm = sender

name: MSG_HIVE_TRACK_SWARM
meaning: Hive case 0x3e04: trackSwarm = 1

name: MSG_GHOST_SET_VULNERABLE
meaning: Ghost case 0x4001: vulnerable = arg with fade; sender Hoover

name: MSG_GHOST_RETHINK
meaning: Ghost case 0x4002: rethink = 1 (ghosts too close)

name: MSG_GHOST_RECOVER
meaning: Ghost case 0x4003: SetState(6) unless catching

name: MSG_GHOST_GET_SUCK_MS
meaning: Ghost case 0x4005: *arg = duration of anim 8 (STANDV1); sender Battery

name: MSG_JAIL_OPEN
meaning: Jail case 0x4300: open (state 2), target bottom height; senders Key, PrayingGhost

name: MSG_JAIL_CLOSE
meaning: Jail case 0x4301: close (state 4), target top height

name: MSG_BATTERY_COLLECTED
meaning: Battery master case 0x4401: collected[] += sender; five -> MSG_HOOVER_CHARGED

name: MSG_BATTERY_SHOW
meaning: Battery case 0x4402: arg ? state 2 : state 4

name: MSG_BATTERY_GET_COUNT
meaning: Battery case 0x4403: returns collectedCount

name: MSG_BATTERY_DRAIN
meaning: Battery case 0x4404: arg 1 start draining, 0 empty -> MSG_HOOVER_DISCHARGED; sender Hoover

name: MSG_BATTERY_CAN_COLLECT
meaning: Battery case 0x4405: collectedCount < 5 && !draining

name: MSG_PGHOST_PRAY
meaning: PrayingGhost case 0x4500: SetState(10)

name: MSG_PGHOST_ALERT
meaning: PrayingGhost case 0x4501: index 0/1 chase (12), others stand (1)

name: MSG_PGHOST_RETURN
meaning: PrayingGhost case 0x4502: SetState(0xe)

name: MSG_PGHOST_APPEAR_MID
meaning: PrayingGhost case 0x4503: ghosts 1/2 at their post appear (3)

name: MSG_PGHOST_APPEAR_OUTER
meaning: PrayingGhost case 0x4504: ghosts 0/3 at their post appear (3)

name: MSG_PGHOST_REGISTER
meaning: PrayingGhost case 0x4505: from the DancingGhostManager, registers with index = arg

name: MSG_INFLATABLE_QUERY
meaning: per receiver: see InflatableSheepMsg, SamMsg

name: MSG_HALO_DRAW_AT
meaning: GhostHalo case 0x4900: draws facing the camera at arg

name: MSG_MARTIAN_IS_CAUGHT
meaning: InstantMartian case 0x4c81: returns 1 in state 4

name: MSG_CANONSHEEP_DUMMY_READY
meaning: CanonSheep case 0x4d01: dummyReady = 1; sender CanonDummy

name: MSG_DOOR_SEQUENCE_DONE
meaning: SceneSheepPanel case 0x4e00: doorSequenceDone = 1; sender DoorWorld

name: MSG_SCENEWHEEL_SAVE_DONE
meaning: Scene_Wheel: msgId == 0x5000 from the MCardManager

name: MSG_RESIZER_RECEIVE
meaning: Resizer case 0x5280: RS_TARGET = arg, placed at the exit (state 3)

name: MSG_DOORWORLD_OPEN
meaning: DoorWorld case 0x5880: asks its DoorLevel and opens; sender SceneSheepPanel

name: MSG_DOORLEVEL_QUERY
meaning: DoorLevel case 0x5900: 0 level not done, 2 current level, 1 done

name: MSG_FIREBALL_STRIKE
meaning: FireBall case 0x5981: burns arg (MSG_KILL) and appears above it

name: MSG_DAFFYWHEEL_TURN
meaning: DaffyWheel case 0x6180: state = 1; sender Scene_Wheel

name: MSG_DAFFYWHEEL_SELECT
meaning: DaffyWheel case 0x6181: state = 2 (arg = language id)

name: MSG_DAFFYWHEEL_RESET
meaning: DaffyWheel case 0x6182: state 2 with camera; sender MCardManager

name: MSG_MARVIN_SOLVED
meaning: Marvin case 0x6480: dialogueFlags.solved = arg; sender InstantHoover

name: MSG_SOCKET_DOCKED
meaning: InstantSocket case 0x6501: anim 0 looped

name: MSG_SOCKET_UNDOCKED
meaning: InstantSocket case 0x6502: anim 1 looped

name: MSG_CROWD_CHEER
meaning: Crowd case 0x6580: wantAnimId 0 or 2

name: MSG_CROWD_CALM
meaning: Crowd case 0x6581: wantAnimId 1 or 3
